nextProject.title: Supermachine Movers

children.text: Supermachine Movers Sdn Bhd has spent more than 40 years relocating and installing heavy machinery across Malaysia and beyond. We designed and built a website with the same qualities as their crews on site — precise, dependable, and quietly impressive — turning an industrial trade into a confident digital presence.

The site walks visitors through the full journey — planning, packaging, transport, installation, positioning, and handover — with animated process steps that make a complex operation feel simple. Dedicated pages for each service, an equipment and facilities gallery, and CIDB certification front and centre give industrial clients exactly what they need to trust the team with their machinery.

workModules.title: Built on Experience. Driven by Precision

children.text: Antara Bubuya x Genting SkyWorlds is a playful, high-energy campaign. We explored key visual directions that could carry the same story across every screen in the park:
One as a vision board of cut-out quotes and images the way you’d put your heroes and idols up on a bedroom wall or your locker door at the gym.
Another taps into the idea of positive reinforcement and plays on the feeling of getting rewarded with stickers and other memorabilia as evidence of a job well done.

work.title: Antara Bubuya x Genting SkyWorlds

children.text: Antara Bubuya brings playful storytelling to Genting SkyWorlds, one of Malaysia’s busiest theme park destinations. We created the campaign’s key visuals and animated screen content — a family of artwork that keeps its charm everywhere, from towering in-park panels to a phone-sized digital ad.

The campaign needed playful key visuals that could jump from printed promotional panels to animated event screens inside a high-traffic attraction. We built a reusable visual system with layered motion elements and scalable composition rules, so every placement — whatever its ratio — tells the same visual story.

With campaign timing tight, asset consistency and quick revision cycles were critical. The system’s modular layers let us adapt artwork for new placements in hours rather than days, keeping the collaboration between the brand and venue teams fast and friction-free.
